NEET (UG) 2025 — Full Mock Test

Test Booklet Code 45  •  National Testing Agency (Provisional Answer Key)

📋 Important Instructions

  • The test is of 3 hours duration and contains 180 multiple-choice questions from Physics, Chemistry and Biology (Botany and Zoology).
  • Each question carries 4 marks. +4 for every correct answer, −1 for every incorrect answer. Unattempted questions get 0. Maximum marks: 720.
  • Use "Save & Next" to save your response and move on. Use "Mark for Review & Next" to flag a question for later.
  • You can navigate freely between subjects and questions using the question palette.
  • The test will auto-submit when the timer reaches zero.
  • Question 63 has two correct options in the official key (both are accepted).
  • You may switch the question language between English and Hindi at any time during the test.

📚 Syllabus / Structure

PhysicsQ. 1 – 45
ChemistryQ. 46 – 90
BotanyQ. 91 – 135
ZoologyQ. 136 – 180
